expect_red: a joint between two parts of one column with a part between them leaves by the column's flank and runs beside that part, its constraints nested, so no route is drawn through a box it does not end on

mutations.contract: A feature whose every interface is with a part in its own column beyond a part between them takes the column's outer flank.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_blade_and_piston_joints_are_authored_as_what_the_parts_show (2026-11-17). Without the flank, the upper piston head of model v2 -- bolted and piloted on the piston body with the lower head between -- leaves its bottom straight into the lower head, and the map reports the two routes drawn through it. Re-pointed 2026-11-18 (the_pitch_plate_is_an_assembly_with_its_bushings), when the flank choice learnt rows too. Re-pointed 2026-11-19 (a_map_pin_faces_each_partner_and_no_two_routes_share_a_run), when a feature's pin side became one per interface.
